english.title: Make economic resources available to designated person - Ukraine
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) without authority of a licence granted by the Treasury, directly or indirectly made economic resources available, namely **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF ECONOMIC RESOURCES..), to a designated person, namely **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF DESIGNATED PERSON..), knowing or having reasonable cause to suspect that you were making the economic resources so available and that the designated person would be likely to, exchange the economic resources or use the economic resources in exchange for funds, goods or services
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 6(1) , 10(1) and 12(1) of the Ukraine (European Union Financial Sanctions) (No.2) Regulations 2014.

english.notes:
(i) Designated person means a person, entity or body listed in Annex I to the Council Regulation.
(ii) Financial benefit includes the discharge of a financial obligation for which the designated person is wholly or partly responsible for.
(iii) The offences does not apply to anything done under the authority of a licence granted by the Treasury. If a licence is revoked by the Treasury, the offence may still be made out as per regulation 9.
(iv) This offence may be committed by conduct wholly or partly outside the United Kingdom when it is conduct of a UK national or a body incorporated or constituted under the law of the United Kingdom.
(v) For the purpose of this offence, economic resources are made available for the benefit of a designated person only if that person obtains or is able to obtain, a significant financial benefit.
(vi) Proceedings for an offence under the regulations may not be instituted in England or Wales unless the consent of the Attorney General has been obtained. See regulation 14. This does not apply for summary offences.
(vii) For procedures regarding proceedings and jurisdiction, please see regulation 13.

other.penalty:
Either way -

Summary: maximum 12 months imprisonment and/or a fine.
Indictment: maximum 7 years imprisonment and/or fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

Note
In relation to an offence committed before section 154(1) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 comes into force, the reference to 12 months imprisonment in relation to summary offences, above, is to be read as a reference to 6 months imprisonment.
